decision.reason: This is a bounded improvement to an existing product the owner already uses. Manual readiness passed, the current landing/auth UI and token cascade have documented defects, and no external product can replace correcting MoneyFlow itself.

problem.statement: MoneyFlow's visual foundation and public/auth entry states are not yet a coherent Calm Ledger experience: token declarations and override layers drift, the first viewport and CTA hierarchy need a bounded contract, and auth must remain financially honest.
observedEvidence: Issue #81 records the current UI audit, rollout order and acceptance criteria.
src/app/globals.css declares the intended design-token source of truth but also retains compatibility aliases and later override risk.
src/components/landing-page.tsx owns the public first viewport and CTA hierarchy.
src/components/auth-form.tsx owns login/register copy and demo-mode messaging.
The owner confirmed all three manual readiness gates passed before redesign work began.
problem.currentWorkaround: Continue patching individual CSS modules and copy without a single feature specification.
problem.workaroundCost: High risk of another override layer, inconsistent entry states and scope expansion into later redesign slices.

existingSolutions.name: Keep the current UI unchanged
existingSolutions.reason: It preserves the documented audit defects and does not meet the owner-approved Calm Ledger direction.

existingSolutions.name: Replace MoneyFlow with an existing finance product
existingSolutions.reason: The task is to improve the owner's existing ledger, data model and workflow; another product cannot modify this repository.

existingSolutions.name: Add a new UI framework or component library
existingSolutions.reason: The repository already has Next.js, React, Tailwind, Radix primitives and reusable components. A new library would add migration cost without proving value.

existingSolutions.name: Use Spec Kit for feature-level specification
existingSolutions.reason: Spec Kit already provides the specification, plan and task workflow. CycleWarden should select and bound the initiative rather than duplicate that layer.

manualTest.method: Review the current production-facing entry states, source files and issue #81 audit before changing code.
manualTest.result: The bounded foundation plus landing/auth slice remains justified; later daily-flow, planning and cross-device slices remain out of scope.

usageCost.interactionCost: No new user workflow is introduced; this slice changes presentation and copy only.
usageCost.maintenanceCost: Must reduce rather than add CSS override layers and must reuse the existing stack.

killCriteria: stop if the work requires changing financial calculations, database schema, RLS or runtime mode
stop if a second token or override source is introduced instead of consolidating the existing source
stop if the slice expands into authenticated daily flows, planning, settings or reports
stop if responsive evidence cannot demonstrate improvement on the supported entry-state viewports
buildEvidence: current product principles and architecture invariants
repository source audit for globals.css, landing-page.tsx and auth-form.tsx
